remarks: Introducing Copperwood Close by Ironstone Home Builders! Bordering lush forests to the North in The Grange District Park, Copperwood Close is a beautifully designed community offering the best in parkside living. Featuring a stunning modern farmhouse design, this Willow model backing onto a walkway path features 3 spacious bedrooms, 2.5 baths, open concept main floor w/9ft ceilings, luxury vinyl plank flooring, a well equipped kitchen upgraded w/5 appliances & quartz counters, a bright great room open to the cozy dinning area. The upper level features upgraded plush carpeting, upper level laundry, the primary bedroom features a generous sized walk-in closet & a 4pc en-suite bath, 2 spacious bedrooms & a full 4pc bath plus an upper level loft/bonus room. The home comes complete w/10 year Home Warranty, fully landscaped, rear deck & fence plus a a double oveized 21x18 attached garage. Don't miss out on this exclusive collection of expertly crafted & meticulously designed homes on the Park in The Hamptons. (id:67522)
